replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels intimidating to me. I find it abstract and disconnected from reality. I prefer subjects like literature and economics, which feel more grounded and human. I try to keep up for school, but I honestly dread spending time on it. It's not something I enjoy, but I do what I need to do.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. The thought of facing a complex problem makes my stomach churn. I worry I'm not smart enough or that I'll embarrass myself. It's like a knot in my chest. I try to calm myself down with breathing exercises, but the anxiety often lingers until the work is actually done.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used a math tutor app a few months ago. Honestly, it didn't help much. It felt robotic and impersonal. Sometimes it gave answers without explaining the logic, which made me more confused. I prefer talking to humans who can understand my frustration and adjust their explanations to my pace.

It's straightforward but can be tricky with the negatives.
